review_evidence: README identifies ZFLean as a practical framework for set-theoretical development in Lean.

A complete proposition-declaration scan found 662 theorem/lemma/example declarations across 10 of the 12 files, including naturals, integers, rationals, functions, embeddings, isomorphisms, booleans, and foundational set definitions.
ZFLean.lean is the library import surface; no build/runtime-only primary material remains in this unit.
summary: Reviewed ZFLean and retain all 12 current-primary files as a theorem-rich set-theoretic development.
